caption: The drawing shows a single metallic wall-mounted lamp or lantern fixture extending from a round, tiered wall plate at the right. The lamp itself is composed of several rounded, concentric shapes that taper downward to a small point at the bottom, with a larger rounded body in the middle and a smaller top. Three curved metal arms arching upward from the body of the fixture connect to the top and are held in place by rounded knobs. The fixture is depicted primarily in shades of brown and bronze, with highlights and shadows giving a sense of metallic texture and dimensionality. The background is plain and uncolored, emphasizing the lamp as the sole object in the composition.
title: Binnacle Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
